test_case.test_name: GPU driver blacklist isolation and restoration
test_case.purpose: Blacklist approved GPU UUIDs, prove they are unavailable to NVQual while allowed GPUs remain usable, then restore the original driver/fabric state.
test_case.test_command: After service-impact approval, capture baseline; drain workloads; stop fabricmanager; unload/reload driver with signed blacklist; verify params/inventory; run allowed-target NVQual and explicit blocked-target refusal; restore original module parameters/services and reverify all GPUs.
test_case.expected_result: Only blacklist targets are excluded/refused, allowed targets pass, and final inventory/services equal baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Absence alone or stress without target identity cannot PASS.
expected_evidence: Allowed PASS and blocked refusal code
test_case.recovery: Reload original module parameters, restore fabricmanager and use OOB reboot only through approved recovery if reload fails.
